final: WITH college_counts AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(group_count) AS total_count FROM college_counts), paired_sum AS (SELECT c.college_id, c.group_count, c.group_count * 1.0 / t.total_count AS count_share FROM college_counts c CROSS JOIN total t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(group_count) AS avg_count FROM paired_sum), paired_average AS (SELECT p.group_count, p.count_share, p.group_count - a.avg_count AS excess FROM paired_sum p CROSS JOIN average_count a WHERE a.avg_count IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT * FROM paired_average WHERE group_count > (SELECT avg_count FROM average_count)) SELECT AVG(group_count) AS average_kept_count, AVG(count_share) AS average_count_share, AVG(excess) AS average_excess FROM kept
